faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Deoghar Lab Assistant Cum Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the AIIMS Deoghar Lab Assistant Cum Data Entry Operator position is 18th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. degree from a recognized university along with a Post Graduate Diploma in Computer Application and relevant experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Lab Assistant Cum Data Entry Operator position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this post is 28 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Lab Assistant Cum Data Entry Operator role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 20,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the AIIMS Deoghar Lab Assistant Cum Data Entry Operator recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to send their complete application via email to the address specified in the official notification before the deadline.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the available information, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST candidates for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Lab Assistant Cum Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a written examination followed by a walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Lab Assistant Cum Data Entry Operator at AIIMS Deoghar.

faq.question: Q9. What kind of experience is required for this role?
faq.answer: A minimum of 1 year of relevant experience as a Laboratory Assistant cum Data Entry Operator in a clinical/research laboratory of a reputed institution is required.
